# Your getaway to the world starts from home

This tagline is choosen, because to go away, you start at home. This can be looking for inspiration, planning, packing and the last you do is close the door and start your new adventure.

Use this website to gain inspiration and information of the places I've visited, and we might meet somewhere on this beautiful Earth!
